info.title: FIRST EPSS
info.description: The Exploit Prediction Scoring System from FIRST — the modelled probability that a CVE will be exploited in the wild within the next 30 days, plus its percentile against every other CVE. Free, keyless, and genuinely batched: many CVEs in one comma-separated request.

get.summary: EPSS probability and percentile for a batch of CVEs
get.description: Returns `{data: [{cve, epss, percentile, date}]}`. `epss` is a probability between 0 and 1 — 0.9 means a nine-in-ten modelled chance of exploitation activity within thirty days. `percentile` ranks it against all scored CVEs, which is usually the more legible number to quote. A CVE with no score is simply absent from `data` rather than returned as zero.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows. The default of 100 truncates a large batch silently, so set it.

200.description: Scores for the CVEs that have one.
